Manrope variable font
Family for CSS: Portfolio Sans (local alias)
Weight axis: 200–800
Style: normal
Full glyph set retained, including Portuguese accents.

Official source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope
Downloaded font: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/manrope/Manrope%5Bwght%5D.ttf
License: OFL.txt (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
FONTLOG.txt retained as requested upstream.
WOFF2 conversion: fontTools and Node.js Brotli, no outline changes.
SVG preview text converted to paths for portable rendering.
